action_relevance.loss: class-weighted cross entropy with inverse train frequency
action_relevance.model: one hidden-layer MLP, 128 ReLU units, three logits
action_relevance.qualification_gate: macro-F1 >= 0.90 and frozen manifest support minimums

binding.loss: masked binary cross entropy with train-derived per-output positive weights capped at 20
binding.normalize: train mean and standard deviation, fitted on train split only
binding.qualification_gate: combined F1 >= 0.90; entity and role F1 reported separately
binding.selection_metric: validation arithmetic mean of entity micro-F1 and role micro-F1
binding.targets: two multi-label heads: entity mention IDs 0..n-1 and role mention IDs 0..k-1
binding.threshold_tuning: separate entity/role thresholds on validation from 0.10 to 0.90 by 0.05; maximize micro-F1; ties closest to 0.50 then larger threshold

failure_policy: record each rung outcome, continue later sensor diagnostics for failure localization, do not claim a passing ladder or train search controllers after any failed gate

feature_contract.action: global_h, mean all constraint_H rows, mean H rows whose public entity incidence contains edited entity, complete assignment one-hot, edit one-hot, role incidence counts in affected constraints, public n/k and affected-constraint fraction
feature_contract.binding: concatenate constraint_H row, task global_h row, and public n/12,k/4 scalars; no incidence features
feature_contract.label_boundary: private typed clause/action labels are offline targets only; never model features

identity.loss: class-weighted cross entropy with inverse train frequency
identity.normalize: train mean and standard deviation, fitted on train split only

purpose: sequential frozen-feature diagnostics; engineering iteration only

shortcut_controls.name_incidence_only_action: same MLP recipe over assignment/edit/public entity-role incidence, no H or h_global
shortcut_controls.template_only_action: same MLP over assignment/edit/public incidence and all/affected counts of template_id 0/1, no H or h_global
shortcut_controls.template_only_identity: train-split template_id majority lookup; qualification balanced accuracy

split_usage.qualification: single held-out qualification report; no tuning
split_usage.train: fit weights and train normalization only
split_usage.validation: select checkpoint and binding thresholds only
